# TrevRPC wire golden vectors.
#
# Every frame is: type (QUIC varint) | length (QUIC varint) | payload.
# Frame types: 0 MESSAGE, 1 REQUEST, 2 HEADERS, 3 STATUS, 6 ANSWER; 0x1f*N+0x21 grease.
#
# Entry kinds (values are lowercase hex; an empty value means zero bytes):
#   <name>.payload  frame payload bytes (protobuf for REQUEST/HEADERS/STATUS,
#                   raw message bytes for MESSAGE)
#   <name>.frame    the complete frame as written by a conforming sender
#                   (minimal varints)
#   <name>.stream   a byte stream a conforming receiver must accept
#   <name>.frames   the known frames a receiver yields from <name>.stream,
#                   comma separated as <type>:<payload hex>; unknown and grease
#                   frames are skipped and therefore absent
#
# Datagram entries (datagram.*) are not frames:
#   <name>.flow      the flow ID as an unsigned integer in hex
#   <name>.messages  the messages, comma separated (an empty value means none)
#   <name>.datagram  the datagram payload a conforming sender writes for them:
#                    flow ID (minimal QUIC varint) | MESSAGE frame per message
#   <name>.received  a datagram payload a conforming receiver decodes to them;
#                    each entry has either .datagram or .received
#
# Logical values:
#   request.unary          RpcRequest{method:"/svc/m"}
#   request.bidi_timeout   RpcRequest{method:"/svc/m", kind:3, timeout_nanos:123456}
#   request.metadata       RpcRequest{method:"/svc/m", metadata:{"authorization":"ok"}}
#   request.datagram_flow  RpcRequest{method:"/svc/m", kind:3, datagram_flow:1}
#   request.connection_metadata_offer
#                          RpcRequest{method:"/svc/m", connection_metadata:{id:1,
#                          metadata:{"authorization":"ok"}}}
#   request.connection_metadata_reference
#                          RpcRequest{method:"/svc/m", metadata:{"x-a":"1"},
#                          connection_metadata:{id:1}}
#   message.hi             MESSAGE "hi"
#   message.empty          MESSAGE with an empty payload
#   headers.metadata       RpcHeaders{metadata:{"x-a":"1"}}
#   headers.empty          RpcHeaders{}
#   answer.connection_metadata
#                          RpcAnswer{connection_metadata:1}
#   answer.empty           RpcAnswer{}
#   status.ok              RpcStatus{code:0}
#   status.unavailable     RpcStatus{code:14, message:"down"}
#   status.metadata        RpcStatus{code:9, message:"stop", metadata:{"x-t":"2"}}
#   grease.two_byte_type   grease frame of type 0x40 (two-byte varint) with payload 000102
#   stream.unknown_frames  grease, HEADERS, an unknown 4-byte type, a MESSAGE with a
#                          non-minimal 2-byte length, grease, STATUS with an 8-byte length,
#                          and an unknown 8-byte type after STATUS
#   stream.answered_response
#                          ANSWER{connection_metadata:1}, HEADERS{metadata:{"x-a":"1"}},
#                          MESSAGE "hi", STATUS OK
